summary: Adds release-track labels, updates the Release issue template, extends milestone enforcement, and introduces the heavy-release CI skeleton for release-ceremony work.
migration_impact: Downstream PLATE repos gain release-major/release-minor/release-patch label support, updated Next Release issue guidance, and release-specific CI/milestone scaffolding. Pull the updated labels, template, workflows, and bootstrap surfaces together to keep the release ceremony aligned.
migration_guidance: 1. Sync .github/labels.yml and any template-payload copies so release-major, release-minor, and release-patch labels exist before relying on release-track automation.
2. Sync .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/release.yml so standing Next Release issues use the updated checklist and readiness fields.
3. Sync .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/label-check.yml, and .github/workflows/pr-issue-link-check.yml together so heavy-release checks and milestone enforcement behavior stay consistent.
4. Re-run bootstrap or copy the updated src/plate_core/bootstrap.py logic into downstream tooling if you rely on automated release-track setup.
agent_notes: When working on release-ceremony changes, keep labels, templates, workflows, and bootstrap behavior in sync; partial adoption will leave release-track automation inconsistent.
